question: Does already-arrived absolute 20cycle capacity forecast error associate with dynamic-minus-fixedhalfCDF absolute RUL loss within each cell?
scope: Existing10cal predictions only; no raw features/checkpoint/newmodel/test
asof: At s use forecast issued s-20 and target_cycle=s; true observed delta only now available. RULtruth for retrospective scoring only.
primary: Per-cell Spearman(abs(predicted_delta-true_delta) at s-20->s, abs(dynamic_RUL_s-y_s)-abs(halfCDF_RUL_s-y_s)); positive suggests large delayed capacity error accompanies less reliable dynamic point than mixture
trend_sensitivity: Per-cell Spearman of consecutive-cycle first differences of both primary signals. No pvalues or independence claim.
secondary: Per-cell Spearman against indicator(dynamic_RUL-y>100)-indicator(halfCDF_RUL-y>100); constant outcomes null.
screen: Descriptive candidate support only if primary positive >=7/10, firstdiff positive >=7/10, and both positive >=7/10. Passing grants no fit/gate; failing NO_GO proxy from current evidence.
missing: Drop origins100..119 with no already-arrived forecast; require exactly4367 unique pairs/10cal. No imputation.
limitations: Repeatedly exposed cal; temporal dependence and age/survivor effects remain; capacity20 forecasting is auxiliary, not recursive EOL
